title: Kuwait-flagged VLCC Kazimah reported hit in Strait of Hormuz
excerpt: Maritime security firm Vanguard Tech identified the Kuwait-flagged VLCC Kazimah as the latest tanker hit in the Strait of Hormuz, the second strike on a Kuwait Oil Tanker Company VLCC in four days.
